name: Parking Brake
description: Gen 6 Camaro uses an electronic parking brake (EPB). Cars with single-piston rear calipers (RPO J71) have a motor on each caliper; cars with the fixed Brembo rears such as ZL1 (RPO J77) use an electric cable-puller module pulling cables to drum-in-hat shoes inside the rear rotors. Race: keep (some rules/transport needs), convert to a hydraulic handbrake, or delete.

components.name: EPB cable-puller actuator / control module (J77)
components.description: Electric motor-gear unit with integral control that tensions the park-brake cables when the console switch is pulled or the car is shut off. A scan tool is required to put it into service (released) mode – GM explicitly says do not force it with jumpers, battery disconnects or mechanical methods.
components.location: Underbody ahead of the rear subframe (approximate – verify on donor), x≈2.35, y≈0.24, z≈0.

factory.name: GM electronic parking brake control module with cable puller (RPO J77)

raceOptions.name: Delete module and cables (park brake not required by many road-race rule sets – check class rules)
raceOptions.notes: Release the system in service mode BEFORE unplugging so shoes are backed off.

hardware.item: Electronic parking brake control module bolt
Electronic parking brake control module bracket bolt

installNotes: If retained: install bracket and module, connect cables, then perform park-brake cable tension/learn with scan tool.
If deleting: place in service mode with a scan tool first, then remove.

components.name: Parking brake intermediate cable / equalizer
components.description: Connects the actuator output to the two rear cables and equalizes tension.

sources.title: TightTorque – Chevrolet Camaro 6 (2016–2024) torque table, compiled from GM 2016–2018 Camaro service manual sections

components.name: Rear parking brake cables
components.description: Sheathed cables from the equalizer to the drum-in-hat shoe actuating levers at each rear backing plate.
components.location: Under the rear floor/subframe to each rear knuckle backing plate.

hardware.item: Parking brake cable bolt (cable bracket to body/knuckle)

installNotes: Route clear of exhaust and halfshafts; check cable is not tight at full droop.
inspection: Check sheath for heat damage near exhaust.

sources.title: TightTorque – Chevrolet Camaro 6 (2016–2024) torque table, compiled from GM 2016–2018 Camaro service manual sections

modelRef.features: Black sheathed cables to the backing plates

components.name: Drum-in-hat parking brake shoes & hardware
components.description: Small brake shoe set with return springs, hold-downs and adjuster inside each rear rotor hat. GM/B&FE note there is no manual workaround – retract/adjust with a scan tool. Replace all springs and clips with shoes.
components.location: Inside each rear rotor hat, mounted to the backing plate.

factory.name: GM rear park brake shoe kit (J77)

raceOptions.name: Delete (remove shoes; retain or replace backing plate)
raceOptions.notes: Prevents shoes contacting a hot drum and dragging.

hardware.item: Shoe hold-down springs, return springs, adjuster

installNotes: Install before the rear rotor; adjust so the rotor turns freely with slight drag, then let the EPB perform its learn.
inspection: Check drum surface and shoe lining when rotors are off.

sources.title: Brake & Front End – Brake Job: 2015-Current Chevrolet Camaro (RPO J55/J6G/JL9, J71/J77 park brake)

images.title: GM 85589610 rear rotor pair – product image (one-piece, coated, drum-in-hat)

modelRef.dimensions: Shoes for ~171 mm drum inside the rear hat
modelRef.features: Two shoes with linings, star adjuster at the bottom, anchor at the top, return springs

components.name: Parking brake switch (console)
components.description: Console pull/push switch commanding the EPB module.

components.name: Hydraulic handbrake (race option)
components.description: Lever-operated master cylinder plumbed inline in the rear circuit (or to separate rear caliper pistons) – used where a functional park/hand brake is needed without the EPB electronics. Must not trap pressure (no residual pressure) and must be compatible with ABS (generally installed downstream with a bypass or omitted on ABS cars).
components.location: Tunnel beside the driver seat, x≈1.6, z≈+0.12.

raceOptions.name: Wilwood hydraulic handbrake with integral master

installNotes: Mount to a reinforced tunnel plate; bleed separately.

modelRef.features: Vertical lever with grip, integral master cylinder at the base
